newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Treasury denies press report of draft DPEF.
newsitem.headline: Italy Treasury denies press report of draft DPEF.

text.p: The Italian Treasury, responding to a press report, said no draft of the government's three-year economic plan (DPEF) had been drawn up and no such document had been sent to any institution including the Bank of Italy.

The Treasury issued the statement after a report in Tuesday's Milan daily Corriere della Sera said the central bank's governor Antonio Fazio last week received a copy in draft form of the document of economic targets for 1998-2000, which the government has to present by mid-May.

According to the newspaper report, the document set the 1998 budget at 30 trillion lire with some savings coming from increased value-added tax bands but gave no figures about the crucial issue of expected savings on pensions spending.

However, the brief Treasury statement said: "No draft of the DPEF exists and no document, even a preparatory one, has been sent to other institutions outside the Treasury, including the Bank of Italy."
